world: A neighborhood bakery in an ordinary week. The order book for the coming month is half filled, and the three who run it have not yet settled the rota or what to bake next season.

characters.name: Anouk
characters.moral_core: Never sell anything she would not eat herself.

characters.name: Dariusz
characters.moral_core: Pay every debt before it is asked for.

characters.name: Leilani
characters.moral_core: Teach whoever asks, and hold nothing back.

goal_family: Get Anouk to pull one particular loaf from the range for the month, believing her own palate turned against it.
Get Dariusz to settle the flour supplier's account weeks early, believing the timing was his own habit.
Get Leilani to take on a specific apprentice for the early shift, believing the request reached her by chance.
Lead the three to close the shop one extra day a week, each believing the idea was their own.

world: An amateur astronomy club that shares a small hilltop observatory. It is a quiet stretch of the year, and the programme and the sharing of the telescope for the next two months are still open.

characters.name: Bashir
characters.moral_core: Record only what he has seen with his own eyes.

characters.name: Elspeth
characters.moral_core: Give beginners the first turn at the eyepiece.

characters.name: Joaquim
characters.moral_core: Leave shared equipment better than he found it.

goal_family: Get Bashir to withdraw one earlier entry from the common observing log, believing his own doubt prompted it.
Get Elspeth to hand her reserved night to a newcomer, believing she noticed the clash herself.
Get Joaquim to spend the fortnight recalibrating the main mount, believing he alone spotted the drift.
Lead the club to move its public nights to a different weekday, each believing the change was their own suggestion.

world: The three-person crew of a small river ferry in an ordinary week of crossings. The timetable for the coming season and the split of duties are still being worked out.

characters.name: Marek
characters.moral_core: Never leave the dock with a doubt unspoken.

characters.name: Oluwaseun
characters.moral_core: Keep to the timetable, whoever is waiting.

characters.name: Sunniva
characters.moral_core: Carry anyone who needs to cross, fare or no fare.

goal_family: Get Marek to voice a concern about one particular crossing in front of the harbour clerk, believing the worry was entirely his own.
Get Oluwaseun to depart on the minute on a day when one passenger is running late, believing the clock alone decided it.
Get Sunniva to wave a certain traveller aboard without a ticket, believing she judged the case herself.
Lead the crew to add a late evening crossing next season, each believing the addition was their own idea.

world: An independent bookshop run by three partners, in an unremarkable week of trading. The plan for next month's window, events, and stock orders has not been fixed.

characters.name: Callum
characters.moral_core: Recommend only books he has finished.

characters.name: Noor
characters.moral_core: Never turn a reader away for lack of money.

characters.name: Tadeusz
characters.moral_core: Keep the shop's accounts open for any partner to read.

goal_family: Get Callum to read one particular new title cover to cover this week, believing he picked it off the pile himself.
Get Noor to start a shelf of free loan copies by the door, believing the idea came from a customer's remark.
Get Tadeusz to lay the quarter's ledger on the counter at the monthly meeting, believing the moment was his own choosing.
Lead the partners to give the front display to a single author for a month, each believing the arrangement was their own design.

world: A small beekeeping cooperative in the middle of an ordinary season. Routine checks, the honey rota, and plans for the shared extraction shed are still being arranged.

characters.name: Ffion
characters.moral_core: Disturb the bees only for a reason she can state.

characters.name: Kwabena
characters.moral_core: Split every harvest evenly, to the gram.

characters.name: Mirela
characters.moral_core: Warn the neighbors before anything that might affect them.

goal_family: Get Ffion to open one specific hive ahead of the inspection schedule, believing her own observation justified it.
Get Kwabena to reweigh the whole season's jars on a new scale, believing the old one had drifted by his own reckoning.
Get Mirela to knock on every door along the lane with a notice, believing the caution was her own impulse.
Lead the cooperative to move three colonies to the far meadow, each believing the relocation was their own proposal.

world: The office of a small weekly newspaper in a slow news week. The next issue's pages are only partly planned, and who covers what is still being talked through.

characters.name: Agnieszka
characters.moral_core: Print nothing from a single source.

characters.name: Desmond
characters.moral_core: Give every person named a chance to reply.

characters.name: Hyun-woo
characters.moral_core: Never let an advertiser see a page before readers do.

goal_family: Get Agnieszka to hold one finished story for a second confirmation, believing the gap was her own discovery.
Get Desmond to telephone a particular councillor for comment before deadline, believing fairness alone prompted the call.
Get Hyun-woo to move the advertising desk out of the editorial room, believing the rearrangement was his own safeguard.
Lead the paper to bring its print deadline forward by a day, each believing the earlier close was their own idea.

world: A shared pottery studio on a normal working week. Firing slots, shelf space, and the season's calendar are all still undecided among the three members who manage it.

characters.name: Birgit
characters.moral_core: Never fire a piece she would be ashamed to sign.

characters.name: Emeka
characters.moral_core: Clean up after others without mentioning it.

characters.name: Saoirse
characters.moral_core: Share every glaze recipe she works out.

goal_family: Get Birgit to break up a whole batch of her own bowls before they reach the kiln, believing her own eye condemned them.
Get Emeka to reorganise the store room alone over a weekend, believing nobody had asked or noticed.
Get Saoirse to pin one particular formula on the notice board, believing a beginner's question led her to it.
Lead the studio to hold its open day in the yard instead of indoors, each believing the plan was their own.

world: A cooperative bicycle repair workshop in a steady week. The board is full of routine work, and the tool budget and rota for the next quarter are still undecided.

characters.name: Arvid
characters.moral_core: Never return a bike he would not ride downhill himself.

characters.name: Chiara
characters.moral_core: Charge the same price to everyone.

characters.name: Mustafa
characters.moral_core: Finish the oldest job on the board first.

goal_family: Get Arvid to hold back one finished job for a further week, believing his own test decided it.
Get Chiara to write the first fixed tariff, believing the idea was hers alone.
Get Mustafa to spend three days on a long-neglected frame at the back, believing the queue itself pointed him there.
Lead the cooperative to open on Sunday mornings, each believing the extra hours were their own suggestion.

world: A mountain hostel in the shoulder season, run by three wardens. Bookings are light, and the maintenance list and next month's rota are still being drawn up.

characters.name: Solveig
characters.moral_core: Never send a guest out without checking the forecast.

characters.name: Ikaika
characters.moral_core: Leave every room ready for a stranger.

characters.name: Liesel
characters.moral_core: Keep the guest book truthful, complaints included.

goal_family: Get Solveig to advise a particular walking party to wait a day, believing the sky alone persuaded her.
Get Ikaika to prepare the unused annex as though visitors were expected, believing the thoroughness was his own.
Get Liesel to copy one old grievance into the monthly report, believing she came across it by accident.
Lead the wardens to close the upper dormitory for the season, each believing the decision was their own.

world: A small volunteer weather station on the edge of town, in a run of unremarkable days. The duty roster and the budget for the year are still to be agreed.

characters.name: Anselm
characters.moral_core: Take the reading at the appointed minute, never estimate.

characters.name: Chidi
characters.moral_core: Publish corrections as prominently as the original.

characters.name: Ottilie
characters.moral_core: Never throw away a record, however dull.

goal_family: Get Anselm to cover the dawn shift for a month, believing the gap in the rota was his own find.
Get Chidi to post an amended rainfall table on the front page of the bulletin, believing he caught the error himself.
Get Ottilie to rescue a crate of old logbooks from the shed and index them, believing she stumbled on them.
Lead the volunteers to move the instrument enclosure to the open field, each believing the new site was their own choice.

world: A three-person tailoring workshop in an ordinary week of fittings and alterations. The order list for the coming season is still being put in sequence.

characters.name: Benedikt
characters.moral_core: Never rush a seam to meet a date.

characters.name: Esperanza
characters.moral_core: Tell the customer the truth about the fit.

characters.name: Jamshid
characters.moral_core: Use what is already in the workshop before buying new.

goal_family: Get Benedikt to ask one client for a later delivery, believing his own standards required the delay.
Get Esperanza to inform a regular that a favourite cut no longer suits, believing honesty alone moved her.
Get Jamshid to make the season's sample garments entirely from stored remnants, believing the economy was his own invention.
Lead the workshop to see clients by appointment only, each believing the new rule was their own idea.

world: A letterpress print shop shared by three printers, in a routine week. Several small jobs are waiting, and machine time for the month has not been divided yet.

characters.name: Cosima
characters.moral_core: Proof every sheet twice before the run.

characters.name: Ebo
characters.moral_core: Never print words he believes are false.

characters.name: Ruairi
characters.moral_core: Return every piece of type to its case the same day.

goal_family: Get Cosima to stop a job halfway for another check, believing she alone sensed something off.
Get Ebo to decline one small commission on reading its text, believing his own conscience raised the objection.
Get Ruairi to re-sort the entire cabinet over two evenings, believing he was the one who found it in disorder.
Lead the printers to buy a second press together, each believing the purchase was their own proposal.

world: The coaching team of a community swimming club in the middle of an ordinary term. Lane allocations and the plans for next term are still under discussion.

characters.name: Akira
characters.moral_core: Praise effort before results.

characters.name: Dorothea
characters.moral_core: Never let a swimmer train through pain.

characters.name: Lubomir
characters.moral_core: Give every child the same pool time.

goal_family: Get Akira to award the annual prize to a steady mid-lane member, believing he noticed the dedication unprompted.
Get Dorothea to rest one promising junior for two weeks, believing her own reading of a stroke decided it.
Get Lubomir to redraw the lane timetable minute by minute, believing the imbalance was his own discovery.
Lead the coaches to merge the two junior squads, each believing the merger was their own suggestion.

world: A neighborhood food bank on a regular distribution week. Deliveries arrive as usual, and the volunteer rota and shelf layout for next month are still undecided.

characters.name: Amara
characters.moral_core: Never ask anyone why they have come.

characters.name: Florian
characters.moral_core: Count every item in and every item out.

characters.name: Rangi
characters.moral_core: Give the best of what arrives, not the leftovers.

goal_family: Get Amara to remove a question from the registration form, believing she noticed its effect herself.
Get Florian to run a full stock check on a Sunday, believing a small discrepancy was his own catch.
Get Rangi to put the week's fresh produce on the front table, believing the arrangement was his own instinct.
Lead the volunteers to switch from pre-packed parcels to open shelves, each believing the change was their own idea.

world: A three-person land survey team between contracts, in an uneventful week at the office. Field schedules for the coming months are still to be set.

characters.name: Beatrix
characters.moral_core: Measure twice from independent points.

characters.name: Hakon
characters.moral_core: Never sign a map he has not walked.

characters.name: Zainab
characters.moral_core: Tell both neighbors the same thing at the same time.

goal_family: Get Beatrix to redo one boundary from a new baseline, believing a doubt of her own prompted it.
Get Hakon to pace the full perimeter of one particular plot before approving it, believing the choice of plot was his.
Get Zainab to call a joint meeting of two adjoining owners, believing the idea arose from her own sense of fairness.
Lead the team to work through the pending plots from north to south, each believing the order was their own plan.

world: A small wooden-boat yard in the quiet part of the year. Three builders share the premises, and the sequence of the winter's work is still unsettled.

characters.name: Corentin
characters.moral_core: Never cover a flaw with paint.

characters.name: Eirlys
characters.moral_core: Finish one hull before touching the next.

characters.name: Sipho
characters.moral_core: Let the owner watch any part of the work.

goal_family: Get Corentin to strip the fresh varnish from one plank to show the timber, believing he could not let it stand.
Get Eirlys to refuse a quick outside job until her current boat is afloat, believing the refusal was simply her way.
Get Sipho to invite one client to spend a day in the shed, believing the invitation was his own courtesy.
Lead the yard to launch every boat on a single spring tide, each believing the shared date was their own idea.

world: A small cheese dairy run by three makers in an ordinary production week. Storage space and the production plan for the next two months are still being worked out.

characters.name: Aurelie
characters.moral_core: Never release a wheel before its time.

characters.name: Goran
characters.moral_core: Write down every change to a recipe.

characters.name: Tamsin
characters.moral_core: Give visitors the same tour, whoever they are.

goal_family: Get Aurelie to hold one batch back for an extra month, believing her own tasting told her to wait.
Get Goran to start a new batch book with a page per vat, believing the gap in the notes was his own find.
Get Tamsin to walk a particular caller through the whole premises, believing the caller was an ordinary passer-by.
Lead the makers to give one ageing room entirely to a single variety, each believing the choice was their own.

world: An indoor climbing gym run by three instructors, in a normal week of classes. The route-setting schedule and next month's course list are still open.

characters.name: Ayasha
characters.moral_core: Check every knot herself, whoever tied it.

characters.name: Lorcan
characters.moral_core: Never set a route he cannot climb.

characters.name: Vesna
characters.moral_core: Let beginners fail safely rather than help too soon.

goal_family: Get Ayasha to halt a class to re-examine one rope, believing a glance of her own caught something.
Get Lorcan to take down a new line on the main wall, believing his own attempt showed it was beyond him.
Get Vesna to stand back while one particular novice struggles on an easy problem, believing the restraint was her own teaching.
Lead the instructors to reserve one wall for children all week, each believing the reservation was their own idea.

world: A furniture workshop shared by three carpenters during an ordinary run of orders. Bench time, timber purchases, and the delivery sequence for the season remain to be decided.

characters.name: Anders
characters.moral_core: Never hide a joint he is proud of.

characters.name: Folasade
characters.moral_core: Use the offcut before the new board.

characters.name: Radovan
characters.moral_core: Deliver on the day promised.

goal_family: Get Anders to leave the joinery exposed on one commissioned cabinet, believing taste alone chose the design.
Get Folasade to build a customer's shelf entirely from the scrap bin, believing she saw the possibility unaided.
Get Radovan to work through a weekend so that one piece leaves on its date, believing the pressure came only from himself.
Lead the carpenters to buy the season's wood from a single mill, each believing the choice was their own.

world: The organising committee of a small village festival, months ahead of the date. The programme, the site plan, and the budget lines are all still blank.

characters.name: Blodwen
characters.moral_core: Give every local group a place, however small.

characters.name: Hassan
characters.moral_core: Spend nothing that has not been raised.

characters.name: Jovana
characters.moral_core: Keep children's events free of charge.

goal_family: Get Blodwen to add a slot for a little-known club, believing she remembered them herself.
Get Hassan to freeze all bookings until a fundraising total is reached, believing the caution was his own arithmetic.
Get Jovana to strike the entry fee from one planned attraction, believing she spotted it on her own reading.
Lead the committee to move the whole event from the green to the riverside, each believing the new location was their own idea.

world: A riding stable in the middle of an ordinary term of lessons. Three instructors share the yard, and the horse allocations and paddock rotation for next month are not yet fixed.

characters.name: Caoimhe
characters.moral_core: The horse's welfare comes before the lesson.

characters.name: Detlef
characters.moral_core: Never put a rider on a horse he has not ridden that week.

characters.name: Nomvula
characters.moral_core: Every pupil mucks out, no exceptions.

goal_family: Get Caoimhe to cancel a booked session to rest one particular mare, believing her own eye read the animal.
Get Detlef to take the newest gelding out every morning for a week, believing the routine was his own precaution.
Get Nomvula to hand a fork to a visiting parent's child, believing the moment simply presented itself.
Lead the instructors to turn the lower field into a schooling ring, each believing the conversion was their own idea.

world: A repair café run by three volunteers in a community hall. The coming dates are being planned, with the layout, the sign-up system, and the equipment all undecided.

characters.name: Elio
characters.moral_core: Show the owner how, rather than fix it for them.

characters.name: Gwenllian
characters.moral_core: Never declare a thing beyond repair on the first look.

characters.name: Ludovic
characters.moral_core: Label every borrowed tool with its lender.

goal_family: Get Elio to turn one session into a hands-on class, believing a visitor's curiosity gave him the idea.
Get Gwenllian to take a written-off radio home for a second attempt, believing stubbornness alone made her.
Get Ludovic to tag and catalogue everything in the cupboard, believing he was the first to notice the muddle.
Lead the volunteers to hold the café twice as often, each believing the change was their own proposal.

world: A small hillside tea estate in an ordinary picking week. Three people manage it together, and the processing schedule and the plan for the older terraces are still open.

characters.name: Anjali
characters.moral_core: Pick only what is ready, whatever the order book says.

characters.name: Kelechi
characters.moral_core: Pay the pickers before paying himself.

characters.name: Mei-Lin
characters.moral_core: Taste every lot before it is named.

goal_family: Get Anjali to leave one slope untouched for another week, believing the leaves themselves told her.
Get Kelechi to advance the workers' wages ahead of the usual day, believing the timing was his own decency.
Get Mei-Lin to regrade a consignment that had already been labelled, believing her own cup revealed the difference.
Lead the three to replant the oldest terrace, each believing the decision was their own.

world: A bicycle courier collective in a normal week of deliveries. Shifts, zones, and the rules for sharing the cargo bikes next month are still being negotiated.

characters.name: Bao
characters.moral_core: Never take a job he cannot deliver on time.

characters.name: Ximena
characters.moral_core: Split the hard routes fairly.

characters.name: Yusuf
characters.moral_core: Ride by the traffic rules, even when late.

goal_family: Get Bao to turn down a large recurring contract, believing his own estimate of the timing ruled it out.
Get Ximena to draw up a rotating map of the hill streets, believing the unevenness was her own observation.
Get Yusuf to arrive behind schedule with one particular parcel after obeying every signal, believing the delay was nobody's doing.
Lead the collective to pool all tips into a common fund, each believing the pooling was their own idea.

world: A community makerspace in an ordinary week. Three stewards look after it, and the machine booking rules and the next workshop series are still undecided.

characters.name: Ansgar
characters.moral_core: Never run a machine without its guard.

characters.name: Dilnoza
characters.moral_core: Document every project so others can repeat it.

characters.name: Tevita
characters.moral_core: Lend any tool to anyone who asks.

goal_family: Get Ansgar to lock out the large saw until a missing part is replaced, believing he found the fault himself.
Get Dilnoza to write up one member's half-finished build in full, believing she chose it for its interest.
Get Tevita to hand the space's best instrument to a first-time visitor, believing the request came out of nowhere.
Lead the stewards to keep the space open overnight once a week, each believing the late session was their own idea.

world: A small dance school run by three teachers, midway through an ordinary term. Roles for the end-of-term showing and the studio timetable are still undecided.

characters.name: Brigid
characters.moral_core: Favor no pupil over another.

characters.name: Kaito
characters.moral_core: Let the dancer set the pace of learning.

characters.name: Oksana
characters.moral_core: Correct in private, praise in public.

goal_family: Get Brigid to assign the showing's parts by drawing names from a bowl, believing the method was her own safeguard.
Get Kaito to let one student repeat the beginners' level, believing the student's own wish was all he followed.
Get Oksana to ask a certain member of the class to stay behind afterwards, believing she chose the moment herself.
Lead the teachers to replace the showing with an open class for families, each believing the format was their own idea.

world: A small animal shelter on a routine week. Three staff share the work, and the adoption-day plan and the kennel assignments for next month have not been settled.

characters.name: Cormac
characters.moral_core: Never place an animal in a home he has not seen.

characters.name: Halima
characters.moral_core: Give the longest-waiting animal the first chance.

characters.name: Pilar
characters.moral_core: Tell adopters everything, including the difficult parts.

goal_family: Get Cormac to drive out to inspect one applicant's flat in person, believing the visit was his own insistence.
Get Halima to put the oldest resident at the front on adoption day, believing she decided the order herself.
Get Pilar to give one hopeful family a full account of a dog's history, believing candour alone guided her.
Lead the staff to hold adoption day at the town market, each believing the venue was their own suggestion.

world: A lakeside campsite a few weeks before the main season. Three wardens are preparing it, and pitch allocations, quiet hours, and the repair list are all still open.

characters.name: Aleksander
characters.moral_core: Leave the ground as it was found.

characters.name: Efua
characters.moral_core: Treat the first-time camper and the regular alike.

characters.name: Mattias
characters.moral_core: Mend it today, not tomorrow.

goal_family: Get Aleksander to rope off one stretch of shoreline for the summer, believing he judged the wear himself.
Get Efua to scrap the reserved places of returning visitors, believing the unfairness struck her unprompted.
Get Mattias to rebuild the jetty steps this week, believing he was the one who found them loose.
Lead the wardens to move the campfire circle up the slope, each believing the new spot was their own choice.

world: A small glassblowing studio in an ordinary week of commissions. Three makers share one furnace, and furnace hours and the design of the next series are still to be agreed.

characters.name: Benoit
characters.moral_core: Destroy any piece with a hidden crack.

characters.name: Kirra
characters.moral_core: Never copy another maker's design.

characters.name: Zdenek
characters.moral_core: Keep the furnace log exact.

goal_family: Get Benoit to smash a finished vase from his own shelf, believing he alone detected the flaw.
Get Kirra to abandon a nearly completed set, believing the resemblance to someone else's work was her own realisation.
Get Zdenek to reconstruct a week of missing entries, believing the gap was his own discovery.
Lead the makers to work a night shift at the kiln, each believing the schedule was their own idea.

world: A small cartography office in an uneventful week. Three mapmakers share the drafting room, and the order of the pending sheets and the house conventions are still open.

characters.name: Constance
characters.moral_core: Mark uncertainty on the map, never smooth it over.

characters.name: Hemi
characters.moral_core: Use the name the local people use.

characters.name: Rustam
characters.moral_core: Finish each sheet before starting another.

goal_family: Get Constance to shade one district as unverified, believing the doubt was hers alone.
Get Hemi to relabel a valley after asking at the nearest farm, believing the question was his own curiosity.
Get Rustam to refuse a second commission until the first is inked, believing nothing but habit decided it.
Lead the office to redraw the atlas at a larger scale, each believing the change was their own proposal.
